description: The plot illustrates the relationship between an unspecified variable on the x-axis and two performance metrics, Recall@50 and NDCG@50, on the y-axes. The x-axis is labeled with integers from 1 to 5, with a linear scale and a tick label interval of 1. The left y-axis represents Recall@50, ranging from 0.30 to 0.60 with a linear scale and a tick label interval of 0.05, while the right y-axis represents NDCG@50, ranging from 0.15 to 0.22 with a linear scale and a tick label interval of 0.01. The plot displays four lines: Recall@50 (Ours) in solid green, NDCG@50 (Ours) in solid blue, Recall@50 (ReFICR) in dotted green, and NDCG@50 (ReFICR) in dotted blue. The solid green line starts at approximately 0.34 at x=1 and increases to around 0.49 at x=5, with a notable rise between x=1 and x=3. The solid blue line begins at about 0.33 at x=1 and rises to approximately 0.46 at x=4 before leveling off. The dotted green and blue lines remain relatively constant across the x-axis, with the dotted green line at around 0.48 and the dotted blue line at approximately 0.158.
